title: BID → Analysis
text: This tool turns burst selections (BID files: first and last photon index of each burst) into burst tables, using the TTTR file with the same stem. The next step loads a ready example so you can watch one conversion end to end.

title: Load the example
text: Press Load example. It writes a simulated photon stream with six known bursts and its BID selection, and queues the BID file. Your own files go in with Add files or Folder.

title: Choose outputs
text: PTO stores the burst table and the original BID inside the measurement container. BUR, SL5 and HDF5 write the legacy table, a photon mask and a columnar table. The detector setup on the left decides the per-detector columns.

title: Convert
text: Press Process. Each queued selection is converted with its TTTR file and the current detector setup.

title: Read the result
text: The status line counts converted files and the table shows each output folder. The example gives six bursts, each with last minus first plus one photons from its BID row.
